newsitem.title: CANADA: One quarter of Canadians believe in ghosts - poll.
newsitem.headline: One quarter of Canadians believe in ghosts - poll.

text.p: One in four people in Canada believes in ghosts, according to a poll released on Thursday to coincide with Halloween.

Respondents in French-speaking Quebec were the least likely to give credence to phantoms and specters, with only 13 percent believing spirits existed, according to an Angus Reid/Southam News Poll of 1,502 Canadians.
A higher percentage of young people -- about 35 percent of those aged 18 to 34 -- said they thought ghosts existed, while only 11 percent of the 55-and-over age group were believers.
Residents of the western province of Alberta were the most credulous, with almost one-third professing a belief in spooks.
